description: This file defines the 'Forms' class within the Goteo project, which implements the ExtensionInterface. It provides methods to generate and handle form elements and states, acting as an extension for form rendering and management, using the Foil templating system.

classes.name: Forms
classes.description: A class implementing form rendering helpers utilizing the Foil extension interface, providing methods like form, start, end, errors, rest, row, widget, label.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initial setup method, currently empty, accepting an array of arguments.

methods.name: provideFilters
methods.description: Returns an empty array of filters.

methods.name: provideFunctions
methods.description: Returns an array mapping function names to class methods for form rendering helpers.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Renders a form or form view, with optional variables and silent mode.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts a form rendering, returning the opening form tag.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Ends a form rendering, returning the closing form tag.

methods.name: label
methods.description: Renders a label for a form field.
